description: Milestone measurement of the L1 PII and DLP programmes (research/l1-pii/README.md, research/dlp/README.md). Read by scripts/generate_docs.py for docs/reference/l1-capabilities.md; the newest file in research/scoreboard/ wins. F1, precision and recall in percent. Milestones, latency and notes are maintained by hand; per-entity and per-group results (pii.entities, dlp.entities, dlp.groups) come from scripts/scoreboard_snapshot.py from-reports (see scripts/l1_presidio/README.md).

milestones.name: EN parity
milestones.value: neutral 9/9, presidio_favored 14/19 shared ids with F1 >= Presidio tuned
milestones.target: every shared id F1 >= Presidio tuned

milestones.name: DE/EU macro-F1
milestones.note: neutral met, presidio_favored not met; met against Presidio default, targets 36.7 / 7.3

milestones.note: value from 2026-10-24, not re-measured; decision 2026-10-24: latency work last

milestones.name: Provider parity
milestones.value: recall >= max(gitleaks, TruffleHog) on all 20 shared entities with gold; FP/MB benign code 0.053 (gitleaks 0.21)
milestones.target: recall >= max(gitleaks, TruffleHog) at FP/MB <= gitleaks

milestones.name: Breadth
milestones.value: 62/206 gitleaks default rules mapped (30.1 %); 72 secret rules / 60 entities; 7 offline structure checks; 15 classes without baseline counterpart
milestones.target: >= 90 % gitleaks rules mapped; >= 150 secret formats; >= 30 offline structure checks; >= 20 classes without baseline counterpart
